# contained in place

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:containedInPlace`](gmeow-containedInPlace.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/containedInPlace>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

Relates a place to a larger place that geographically contains it; transitive. Chains the nested granularity (room ⊂ building ⊂ city ⊂ region ⊂ country), each level a first-class place. Non-functional: contested sovereignty claims (e.g. Crimea-class) coexist as standpoint-indexed statements ([`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md)), never collapsing to a single winner ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md) -> [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:containedInLocation`](gmeow-containedInLocation.md), [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md)

Use [`gmeow:containedInPlace`](gmeow-containedInPlace.md) from [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md) to [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
